_comment: Questions about the five documents in documents/, written after the documents were frozen and before any chunker existed. 'evidence' lists one or more alternatives; each alternative is the set of passages that together answer the question, copied exactly from the documents (each passage occurs exactly once in them). A table row comes with its header row, a procedure with all its steps, a release note with its version heading. Scoring rule, fixed with the questions: a question's evidence is found when, for at least one alternative, every passage is contained in the text of a single retrieved chunk, as the model receives it, including heading lines a strategy copies into the chunk (different passages may be in different chunks). 'answer' is the reference for grading replies by hand. 'category': simple (one sentence), heading (the answer is in the section heading), table, list (steps or items), multi (two places, often a cross-reference). 'split': alternating within each category in the order written, starting with dev; dev questions choose settings, test questions report results.

questions.question: How do I set up single sign-on?
questions.answer: The 8 steps in section 4.2 of the Administrator Guide.

evidence.text: 1. Go to Settings > Security > SSO and select Set up SAML.
2. In your identity provider, create a new SAML application.
3. Configure the identity provider to send the email address as the NameID
4. Assign the application to the people and groups
5. Copy the identity provider's metadata URL
6. Select Test connection.
7. When the test succeeds, choose whether to enforce SSO.
8. If you enforce SSO, members who haven't signed in through SSO yet get a grace period of 7 days

questions.question: How do I connect SCIM provisioning?
questions.answer: The 4 steps in section 5 of the Administrator Guide.

evidence.text: 1. Go to Settings > Security > SCIM and select Generate token.
2. In your identity provider's SAML application, turn on SCIM provisioning.
3. Choose which provisioning actions to allow
4. Assign a test user and check that they appear under Settings > Members

questions.question: How do I verify a webhook delivery?
questions.answer: The 5 steps under Verifying a webhook.

evidence.text: 1. Read the raw request body, exactly as received
2. Join the X-Timestamp value, a period, and the raw body into one string.
3. Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of that string
4. Compare the result with the X-Signature header using a constant-time comparison.
5. Check that X-Timestamp is no more than 5 minutes old.

questions.question: What do we have to do before we can downgrade to Basic?
questions.answer: The 5 steps in the Downgrading section.

evidence.text: 1. Archive projects until no more than 3 are active.
2. Remove or suspend members until no more than 5 remain
3. Remove guests from any project that has more than 10.
4. Delete files until storage is under 10 GB.
5. Turn off single sign-on, SCIM, and the IP allowlist.
